name: b1-demo-factory-standalone
description: Standalone dependency set for running the demo factory's RENDER stage outside the monorepo (tools/remote-render.mjs). Inside the workspace this file is inert: it is not a yarn workspace, and the pipeline keeps resolving its dependencies from the app server's node_modules. On a remote machine, `npm install` in this directory pulls everything the render needs — all public packages, no CodeArtifact. Versions must track the app server's package.json; see the render section of README.md.
